dependency_stages.gap: No isolated recognition latency/communication timing; choose one recognition process, not four full speed bonuses. S46 only when team calls are actually modeled.
Navigation applies with an actual obstacle; containment applies to the live drive threat, not an automatic additional closeout grade. Starting geometry belongs in state.
S40 technique and measured braking capacity are not interchangeable. No source actor has complete measured motion/balance here.

state: actual release time and ball position
dependency_stages.gap: C37 shares S37 with C27 but not a second full interior response. No height+span+standing-reach+rim-summary stack.
Use only the relevant mode/branch, not the union as a compulsory full-profile requirement. FT skill is excluded. A delayed/abandoned shot is not necessarily a miss.
S24 only when shooter contact craft is modeled. S45 is legal execution, not T16 willingness. Joint make/block/foul result must be coherent, including made-and-fouled cases.
Immediate spatial recovery uses movement/control; P12 is between-effort physiological recovery, not instantaneous teleporting or a second foot-speed bonus. Workload branch only when state is modeled.

controlled_comparisons.hold: same start/velocity, capacity, shooter release process and responsibility
controlled_comparisons.vary: earlier/later decision, then movement capacity separately
controlled_comparisons.expectation: Earlier recognition can permit earlier controlled arrival; do not attribute all delay to speed. No fixed millisecond target.

controlled_comparisons.hold: same closest body distance and release time
controlled_comparisons.vary: hand up/down, front/side/behind approach, contest timing and reach separately
controlled_comparisons.expectation: Near does not guarantee useful pre-release contest. A late hand cannot retroactively suppress an already released shot; later contact may still matter legally.

controlled_comparisons.vary: controlled approach versus excessive momentum at declared physical capacity
controlled_comparisons.expectation: Closer arrival may cost blow-by exposure or foul/recovery control; better S40 need not maximize blocks. Do not fit a universal all-out sprint advantage.

controlled_comparisons.hold: same defender trajectory and delivery readiness
controlled_comparisons.vary: S08, then catch/pull-up/movement branch and shot distance separately
controlled_comparisons.expectation: Available release window and contest can change; do not double-charge inherited accuracy for the same access problem. Midpoints are not measured release times.

controlled_comparisons.vary: standing reach, jump state, then timing separately
controlled_comparisons.expectation: Physical access must be feasible; no triple height/span/reach bonus, no C36 extra multiplier, no automatic big-over-guard contest order.

controlled_comparisons.vary: shot, pump/drive, pass and landing/contact context
controlled_comparisons.expectation: Report selection, legal/illegal contact, attempt/make/block and post-action recovery consistently. No mandatory shot or independent contradictory block/make/foul draws.

controlled_comparisons.hold: matched responsibility, start, shooter mix and exposure definition
controlled_comparisons.vary: White/Castle help versus attached POA; Barnes secondary help versus big anchor; source shooter alternatives
controlled_comparisons.expectation: A broad scouting rank is not the target. Include all threats, declined shots and later recovery costs alongside per-attemptFG%; identify unknown controls when order reverses.

minimum_additional_inputs.for_direct_C37: Missing source geometry/motion/balance/jump and relevant S37/S40/S45 per declared defender, or explicit isolated controls; never generic hidden completions.
minimum_additional_inputs.for_rotation: Threat/assignment, recognition/start state, path and approach velocity, with uncertain C26 ingredients; communication only if modeled.
minimum_additional_inputs.for_shot: Actual shooter readiness, release/mode/distance, trajectory; source-unknown preparation/range/balance controlled openly.
minimum_additional_inputs.for_legal_recovery: Contact/landing geometry, continuing assignment, post-contest velocity/control; workload only if fatigue state modeled.
minimum_additional_inputs.physical_recovery_warning: P12 is physiological recovery between efforts, not spatial recovery movement.
